actions.name: vampiric connection
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s senses.

actions.name: umbral dagger
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, the target becomes Stable but has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition for 1 hour. While it has the Poisoned condition, the target has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition.

actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes the &Reference[Dash] or &Reference[Disengage] action.
